contexts.text: Because thou ascendedst thy father's beds () = because, when separated from the good which is of charity, it has filthy conjunction. AE 484:17. AE 817:5.
Bed, couch, and bed, have a similar signification to this, Illustrated.

As a bed signifies doctrine, it was a statute of the Church among the Sons of Israel, that every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue is unclean; and that the man who hath touched his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in waters ().
How has it become a waste, a couching place of the wild beast () = that there is nothing of truth there, but that it is full of falsities. AE 650:57.
The truths and goods they will have, are signified by a place to lie down in, where before there were dragons ().
